readiness_evidence: Not ready to offer: the support ingest that receives automatic fault reports must be redeployed and smoke-tested first, and no hosted session has run this version yet.

Hosted replay: not run. Sign-in (the Link approval link is now always shown before polling), calendar (connect or skip only after the calendar question), and payment (policies accepted before paying, pay-at-service completed in two steps) changed and need one throwaway hosted booking before rollout.

Breaking for a mismatched skill: a booking now needs the user's yes on the summary (and on the business's policies when it sent any) through new flags, so a 0.56.0 skill driving this CLI stops at the new gates with recoverable errors. The bundled skill 0.57.0 matches.

Offline: the full test suite passes, including loopback end-to-end runs where checkout terms and privacy links block payment until accepted, and replays of the AC repair transcript that motivated the gates.

Existing businesses and the registry stay compatible: no USP, UCP, or platform profile version changed and no request shape changed; results whose profile cannot be resolved are now dropped client-side.
The saved booking file keeps its format version and gains only optional fields; a session saved by 0.8.0 resumes, and the new confirmations are asked again where needed.

Hosted replay (grok-bot): on 22/10/26 Grok Bot ran 0.9.1, which carries all 0.9.0 changes, and completed a $1 HVAC-Koby booking after showing the saved recap and checkout policies, waiting for the user's yes, and using a Link approval shown once.

Hosted replay (grok-bot): Update Bot's Computer changed the boot id while preserving the selected booking and Link sign-in; the resumed booking confirmed, stated that no calendar event was added because this harness cannot pass its connector token, answered status from the saved booking, and runtime doctor reported healthy true with no findings.
The support ingest was redeployed and smoke-tested on 21/10/26: malformed JSON was rejected and a schema-valid support note was delivered.

user_summary: The assistant now shows you the booking summary and the business's policies and waits for your yes before anything is booked or paid.
